description: This PHP class defines a plugin component for the Revive Adserver, specifically for handling log conversion variables within the openXDeliveryLog plugin. It manages bucket and statistics table names, dependencies, and data migration mappings related to ad impression and conversion tracking.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogConversion_LogConversionVariable
classes.description: A plugin class for handling log conversion variables in the openXDeliveryLog plugin, extending the Plugins_DeliveryLog base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting the type to 'raw' and calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: onInstall
methods.description: Performs installation steps; currently does nothing and returns true.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of dependencies for this plugin component.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for this log conversion variable.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns an array of columns in the bucket table; currently empty.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated bucket data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping configuration for migrating bucket data into statistics tables, including table names, primary keys, and source/destination columns.
